items.title: # Reality Thread 9 + 110 Million Essence Staked!
items.excerpt:
Two new articles covering gameplay, platform updates and a major milestone! 🎉
🚀 Reality Thread 9: Command Deck Online
Our long-awaited RT9 article is here! Explore Cydroid raiding, all 38 Cydroids, flight and combat, squad play, Pilot progression, perks, leaderboards and rewards.
There's plenty beyond raiding, too:
🌏 Player Stalls and local trade, plus Global Locations and geographic labels.
🌏 Avatar spear and shield combat improvements, meals designed for future Horde combat and updates to the multiplayer Beach Ball physics.
🌏 F-Wheel shortcuts, persistent Character Action Bars, refreshed inventory icons and the ACE Cydroid Uplink.
🌏 Launcher 2.0.0, VELA voice guidance and language support, graphics and performance improvements, and in-game bug reporting.
👉 https://earth2.io/news/reality-thread-9
💎 110 Million Essence Staked
Players have now actively staked 110 million $ESS on properties, equivalent to 11% of the original maximum supply!
Read the Q1–Q3 2026 Essence report, learn more about the future role of staking in Hordes and selected minigames, and discover expanded Brilliant Jewel benefits, including up to 300% of normal daily O.U. output.
Also included is the skin gift return system in My Skins, designed to help resolve remaining affected gifts. Eligible Players who help complete verified recoveries during the initial 30-day period can qualify for a special Cydroid skin planned for 2027.
👉 https://earth2.io/news/110-million-ess-staked
Thank you for continuing to help
linesKo: 리얼리티 스레드 9 기사가 공개됐어요. 사이드로이드 레이딩과 38종 사이드로이드를 다뤄요.
플레이어 스톨, 아바타 전투 개선, 런처 2.0.0 등 플랫폼 업데이트도 함께 소개돼요.
프로퍼티에 스테이킹된 에센스가 1.1억 $ESS를 넘었고, 최초 최대 공급량의 11%예요.
